label: champ_0125_rival_01
text: Hey, I heard the good news! Congrats on Gym\nBadge number six![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0125_rival_02
text: Not even a tenth of the Trainers who take on\nthe Gyms get this far, y’know![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0125_rival_03
text: But I’m not surprised that you made it. I just\nKNEW there was a reason you caught my eye![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0125_rival_05
text: Oh please! I should be the one thanking you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0125_rival_06
text: Well, trust me—I could tell from our very first\nbattle you were gonna grow seriously strong![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0125_rival_07
text: Aaanyway...I bet you could use a little warming\nup before you take on the Gym, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0125_rival_08
text: C’mon! You know the drill by now![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
